general_information.Description: The course is designed to enable students to: - develope English language and communicate skills for the workplace, do business, cross-cultural understanding, and business case study analysis - apply these skills in the final Capstone Project by analysing a current business case study and providing recommendations to a target audience in both presentation and written formats. 1) Ongoing assessment: Student gets 0.5 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1. 2) Practical Exam (PE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, PE+ Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: PE>=4 and FR>=5
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (optional) 6. Must complete all required MOOCs with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Enhance your vocabulary and reading skills, and your understanding of tone, style and knowledge of communication methods.; and apply these language skills to enhance audience analysis, business case analysis and basic business communication strategies.
Develop use of vocabulary, grammar, understanding of different business writing genres, and your ability to write professional business documents.

assessments.Grading Guide: Teacher(s) interview students to check their understanding and utilization of language acquired from the spec. There should be 4-7 questions covering topics in the spec.
